title: VisionFaceLibraryRequest
description: vision.face-library-request@1: POST /api/v1/faces/library/cluster (region-gated), GET /library/groups and POST /library/correct. `action` is cluster (default), exclude, merge or split; `ids` names up to 100 of the caller's own clusters; `region` is a jurisdiction code the host allows. Unknown faces stay unlabelled.
